info.name: Qovery Account Info Environment Deployment History API

params.name: startId
params.description: Starting point after which to return results

items.docs: List previous and current environment deployments with the status deployment and the related services. By default it returns the 20 last results. The response is paginated. In order to request the next page, you can use the startId query parameter

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of deployments to return in the current page

items.docs: List previous and current environment deployments with the status deployment and the related services. By default it returns the 20 last results. The response is paginated. In order to request the next page, you can use the startId query parameter

info.name: Generate a Grafana snapshot report showing build runner pod usage for a specific deployment

items.docs: Generate a Grafana snapshot report that shows the resource usage (CPU, memory) of build runner pods for a specific deployment execution. The report is publicly accessible for the specified duration.
